notes.title: Olé - Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello players!

We are at an early stage of project development, implementing the players on the field and their interactions.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/a03a55de729bc9d09bc35505a00bb6ff7c0e4502.gif[/img]

We still have a lot of work to do, but we want to show a little piece of the game in action.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/f225fab250551b1fa5b400f1591eb9b2db8382a7.gif[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/6c6f4b55c66e4951abeeb458f110fa4b6234060b.gif[/img]

We are already testing player interactions such as dribbling, passing and kick to goal.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/64093d923677fa4c25c037120dc2398ab85cdc6a.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/a743146c79b2224ab64d245837183de3de61df0b.gif[/img]

notes.title: Sufoco is releasing now!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33024181/49d514e694c5ab2156b5b855cae6a63b6b4925d5.png[/img]

[h1]Hello Wizards![/h1]


For the release version, a new and more challenging mode was added! The random rooms mode!

In this mode, if you lose, the game loads a different level to play.
Don't worry, your progress in the levels that you won will be maintained.

Enjoy and a have a magical day!
